subject: Clarification of Leaf Area Indicies and change through time (mico_ncep)

messages.author: 15914ff4afa133aa
messages.subject: Clarification of Leaf Area Indicies and change through time (mico_ncep)
parts:
Hi Michael,

Within the micro_ncep function, there are two parameters related to Leaf Area Index. One is for use in the micoclima package while the other is used for evapotranspiration. What is the proper way to implement these separate parameters that have different default values?

The microclima package can create daily estimates of LAI depending on vegetation type. I would like to incorporate these data, but two LAI parameters in mico-ncep do not appear to accept vectors. Is there a way to supply the model with these data similar to the way that MAXSHADES can be supplied with a vector?

Best,
Andrew

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Clarification of Leaf Area Indicies and change through time (mico_ncep)
parts:
Hi Andrew,

I agree it is confusing that they have different defaults. I made it zero for microclima, because it uses lai to compute radiation hitting the ground and by default minimum shade is zero so you want lai to match that. The other lai is used in soil moisture calculations to partition the transpiration and evaporation in terms of whole-profile soil moisture, so they are doing different things. Note that you can pass a vector of daily values to the (non-microclima) lai input, to capture temporal changes. I've now made this clear in the help. You could pass a vector to the microclima lai input too but the microclima calculations just use the mean of these in the end.

All the best,
Mike
